description: Reviewed, consciously accepted security advisories. scripts/check-dependency-audit.mjs blocks CI on any high/critical production advisory NOT listed in 'advisories'; scripts/check-supabase-advisors.mjs blocks on any WARN/ERROR Supabase security-advisor finding NOT listed in 'database'. Both block on any entry past its 'expires' date — an acceptance is a dated decision that must be re-reviewed, never a permanent mute. Add an entry only after checking reachability/impact; record how you checked in 'reason'.

database.reason: Reviewed definitions 2026-10-12. The auth_* helpers and is_growth_user only test the CALLER's own relationship via auth.uid() (null for anon → false); they are RLS policy helpers (SECURITY DEFINER avoids policy recursion) with search_path pinned. increment_insights_view only bumps view_count on a published article — worst case is inflated public view counts.

Reviewed definitions 2026-10-12. Every auth_*/is_* helper is scoped to auth.uid() — it reveals only the caller's own relationship/role, which RLS policies need. get_grade_topics returns public curriculum substrand titles. All have search_path pinned.
Hygiene, not exposure: pg_trgm functions in public are harmless. Moving the extension risks breaking existing trigram indexes; revisit with a planned migration.

FOUNDER ACTION, short expiry on purpose: enable in Supabase Dashboard → Authentication → Settings (HaveIBeenPwned check; may require the Pro plan). Resurfaces as a nightly failure on expiry if still off.

advisories.reason: DoS in the JXL/HEIF image parsers. Not reachable: lib/slides/pptxBuilder.ts (the only pptxgenjs user) builds slides from shapes/text/colours and never calls addImage, so image-size never parses input. Re-verified 2026-10-12 (no addImage/image-size use in lib/app/components). No upstream fix.
DoS in the ICNS image parser. Not reachable for the same reason as GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq: no image is ever added to a generated deck. Re-verified 2026-10-12. No upstream fix.
